decision.explanation: The source documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the artist of the album 'Out of the Box'. Document 1 (D1S1) and Document 2 (D2S1) explicitly state that 'Out of the Box' is the debut mini-album released by 'Jade Valerie'. Document 3 (D3S1) contains a Wikipedia snippet listing 'Taylor Swift' as the artist for an album titled 'Out of the Box' released on the same date (October 17, 2007). As the prompt instructs to treat distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers as coexisting and not to silently equate competing assertions, both 'Jade Valerie' and 'Taylor Swift' are retained as valid answers based on their respective source evidence. Candidates 'Tony James' and 'Vivian Bayubay' (C2, C3) are rejected as they are identified in D4S5 as hosts of a Disney Channel show named 'Out of the Box', not the artist of the album.
